claim: Les Prés d'Eugénie covers 8 hectares with 5 historic buildings and 45 rooms/suites, all within the estate.
quote: 45 bright rooms and suites, scattered across gardens and historical buildings

claim: Room categories and rates across the Guérard estate: Maison Guérard (Classic/Superior from €270, De Luxe from €500, Suites from €550, Royal from €700, Imperial from €900); Couvent des Herbes (Deluxe from €330, Suites from €450, Le Temps des Cerises from €550); Logis des Grives (Deluxe from €330, Village Suites from €450).
quote: Classic & Superior Rooms: From €270; Imperial Suites: From €900; Le Temps des Cerises: From €550; Suites in the Convent: From €450; Deluxe Rooms: From €330

claim: Les Prés d'Eugénie is ranked #1 of 4 hotels in Eugénie-les-Bains with 4.7/5 across 1,119 reviews and a Travelers' Choice Best of the Best 2025 award; address Place de l'Impératrice. Critique threads mention worn furnishings in some rooms and steep breakfast surcharges.
quote: Rating & Ranking: 4.7 of 5 stars (1,119 reviews); #1 of 4 hotels in Eugenie Les Bains. Travelers' Choice Best of the Best 2025

claim: La Maison Rose is a 3-star Guérard guest house at 334 Rue René Vielle with Classic/Comfort rooms from €160, Superior from €170, Junior Suites from €180.
quote: Classic & Comfort Rooms - From €160; Superior Rooms - From €170; Junior Suites - From €180

claim: La Maison Rose has 8 superior rooms (21–25 m²), 4 junior suites (28–30 m²), plus 24 classic/comfort rooms (15–21 m²), and sits in a meadow with heated pool, fireplaced lounges, and a tearoom.
quote: 8 rooms ranging from 21 to 25 m²... 4 junior suites ranging from 28 to 30 m²... 24 classic and comfort rooms ranging from 15 to 21 m²

claim: La Ferme aux Grives, the Guérard country bistro on the estate, also houses 4 suites (40–60 m²) and Deluxe Rooms in the Logis des Grives, with terracotta tiles, aged beams, Arudy-stone bathtubs and canopy beds.
quote: 4 Suites on the other side of the river in the vegetable garden enclosure, with original architecture spanning 40 to 60 m²

claim: La Ferme aux Grives is rated 4.1/5 on 86 TripAdvisor reviews and ranked #2 among Eugénie-les-Bains hotels; breakfast included.
quote: La Ferme aux Grives | 4.1/5 | 86 | Breakfast included

claim: Le Clos Nicolas is a 3-star hotel with 20 rooms and 6 suites located 400 m from the thermal baths and village centre, set beside the Bahus river.
quote: 20 chambres et 6 suites... à seulement 400m des Thermes et du centre du village d'Eugénie-les-bains

claim: Le Clos Nicolas is rated 4.3/5 over 61 TripAdvisor reviews and ranked #5 of Eugénie-les-Bains hotels, with mixed feedback on facility upkeep (closed indoor pool, gym).
quote: Le Clos Nicolas | 4.3/5 | 61 | Noted for spacious accommodations

claim: Hotel Le Relais des Champs is at 339 Route Nicolas, located 300 m behind the Thermes d'Eugénie toward the village of Classun; its studios sit ~50 m from the thermes.
quote: Located 300 meters behind the Thermes d'Eugénie, in the direction of the village of Classun. The studios are the closest to the thermal baths at 50 meters

claim: Le Relais des Champs has 26 rooms and 4 ground-floor suites with standard rooms €80–90, suites €122, restaurant daily menu €19.50; Booking guest score 8.6 with 9.2/10 location.
quote: 26 rooms and 4 ground floor suites... Room prices range from €80-90 for standard rooms and €122 for suites... 8.6 by recent guests with an excellent location rating of 9.2/10

claim: Hotel Le Relais des Champs holds 4.0/5 on 115 TripAdvisor reviews; described as a well-maintained family hotel with pool, gardens, bicycle rental.
quote: rated 4 out of 5 on TripAdvisor based on 115 reviews

claim: Chez Léonie is a 2-star family hotel at 113 rue René Vielle, opposite the thermal facility, with 11 rooms; doubles €65–72, half-board €72–102/person, breakfast €7–10. Includes ground-floor wheelchair-accessible option.
quote: 11 total rooms... Double room: €65-72... in the heart of the village located across from the thermal facility

claim: Chez Léonie is rated 4.9/5 on TripAdvisor (small sample of 8 reviews) — highest individual score among village hotels.
Camping des Sources is a 4-star campsite 900 m from the thermal baths with 125 pitches plus 43 chalets/mobile homes, open Feb–Dec.
quote: 900 meters from the Eugénie-les-Bains thermal baths... 125 pitches across 2.7 hectares... 43 air-conditioned chalets and mobile homes

claim: The Guérard estate's buildings stand a few dozen metres from each other, so all 45 rooms/suites across the historic houses are within easy walking distance of the dining room.
quote: the two houses standing a few dozen metres from each other... all within walking distance

claim: Chez Léonie was founded in 1956 by Léonie Baqué and remains a family-run village hotel with bar/restaurant.
quote: Chez Léonie is a family-run establishment that was created in 1956 by Léonie Baqué

claim: TripAdvisor lists only five hotels in Eugénie-les-Bains: Les Prés d'Eugénie, La Ferme aux Grives, Chez Léonie, Le Relais des Champs, Le Clos Nicolas — essentially every walking-distance option. Camping des Sources scores 4.2/5 on 29 reviews; strict cancellation policy flagged.
quote: Top Hotels by TripAdvisor Rank: 1 Les Prés D'eugénie; 2 La Ferme aux Grives; 3 Chez Léonie; 4 Hotel Le Relais des Champs; 5 Le Clos Nicolas
